light_description: Indonesian low-to-mid gain overdrive with substantial headroom and an independent Pre-Gain clean-boost stage; documented since 2016.
Indonesian dual-stage fuzz/distortion associated with RAT and Big Muff-style tonal territory; documented in the FM Pedals catalog and Indonesian press.
Indonesian high-gain distortion documented as a core FM Pedals release and covered by independent pedal media.
Indonesian distortion named for Papua and documented as one of FM Pedals' early dirt releases.
Indonesian overdrive documented in current Indonesian dealer listings under FM Pedals.
Indonesian clean booster identified in local pedal coverage and later pedal databases; retained as gain-adjacent rather than a standalone distortion family.
Artist-associated FM Pedals signature product documented in pedal databases and tied to Indonesian guitarist Andra Ramadhan.
